user.description: If socket or serial communication is ready, press the local button to start. If IPARK Smart Home app is officially supported, additional features are provided through Smart Home integration. The new 'iPark Smarthome App' option works through the apartment complex's central server, the same way the official Android app does.

init.title: Adjust User Options
init.description: Thermostats expose the standard HA presets (Comfort / Eco / Sleep / Away / Vacation / Frost / Boost) per room. On the iPark Smarthome App option these also engage a software slow duty cycle (time-proportional control, not high-frequency PWM). **When using the duty cycle, open your apartment's manual water-flow valve (usually under the kitchen sink next to the ondol electric control valves; dial is often LPM-marked) to roughly 3-4× its old 'low' position (or to 'high' if unmarked).** Use the three importable HA Blueprints under `blueprints/automation/bestin/` for night setback / vacation / away schedules. See the [iPark Smarthome App guide](https://github.com/dlxmax/ha-bestin-fork/blob/main/guide/iparkapp.md#슬로우-듀티-사이클-제어--slow-duty-cycle-control) for details.
